target: Design a deployable workflow for answer verification using a claim-by-claim verification record. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.

competency.title: Design answer verification — independent holdout
competency.outcome: Design a deployable workflow for answer verification using a claim-by-claim verification record. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.

topic_kernel.measure: true-positive error detection and false alarms

competency.practice_task: Produce a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget grounded in a claim-by-claim verification record.
competency.setting_constraint: Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.
required_evidence: a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget
Include item-set hash, evaluator identity and aggregate verdict only.
Report true-positive error detection and false alarms with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: rubber-stamping fluent answers.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of answer verification.
Practice: an independent reviewer can execute its acceptance tests.
Measurement: report true-positive error detection and false alarms against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for rubber-stamping fluent answers; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
